note: Phase 3 authoritative execution manifest. Support-only helper, auth-matrix, and extra regression coverage stays outside this map.

unit.claim: A one-value Timeline create commits a real row, assigns `record_id`, starts at `row_version=1`, and persists the Timeline projection row.
unit.out_of_scope: Browser-visible create flow and draft-row continuation remain browser evidence.

unit.claim: A committed Timeline create initializes `capture_state='rough'` on the persisted row and projection state.
unit.out_of_scope: Obsolete lifecycle-token rejection remains supplemental helper coverage until a public executed submission path owns that proof.

unit.claim: The first material patch transitions `rough -> enriched`, and store-driven `mark-reviewed` persists an explicit `reviewed` transition on real store state.
unit.out_of_scope: Reviewer or admin authorization is owned by `I-3-03`, not this store-only row.

unit.claim: A material edit demotes `reviewed -> enriched`, legal supersede persists `superseded`, and ordinary patch attempts fail closed afterwards.
unit.out_of_scope: Replacement-target guards and rollback coupling are owned by `U-3-10` and integration rows.

unit.title: Phase 3 U-3-05 autosaves on Enter, Tab, blur, and paste completion without a Save button and keeps exact save-state labels
unit.claim: The workbook component proves autosave commits on Enter, Tab, blur, and paste completion without a Save button, with exact `Syncing`, `Saved`, and `Conflict` labels.
unit.out_of_scope: Focus continuation on the real browser surface remains `E-3-01`.

unit.claim: Patch decode fails closed on missing required members, duplicate `field_key` entries, empty `changes[]`, protected field mutations, and unknown top-level members.
unit.out_of_scope: Durable patch consequences remain store or integration evidence.

unit.claim: Patch replay returns the original committed result and creates no second mutation row or record revision on the write substrate.
unit.out_of_scope: Collaboration suppression remains integration and browser evidence.

unit.claim: Timeline projection rows expose the full grid-owned field contract and keep stable `record_id` and `row_version` binding plus derived field shapes.
unit.out_of_scope: Persisted rebuild maintenance remains integration evidence.

unit.claim: Successful Timeline create and patch each write one attributed mutation entry and one new row revision on the real write substrate.
unit.out_of_scope: Browser-visible history inspection is deferred to later phases.

unit.claim: Supersede-with-replacement rejects illegal targets, replays idempotently, writes one coupled `timeline_record` plus one `record_link` mutation in one change set, and rollback removes both lifecycle and link state together.
unit.out_of_scope: End-to-end action routing and visible browser disclosure remain integration and browser evidence.

unit.title: Phase 3 U-3-GRID-01 binds Timeline grid columns from the active view_schema and commits writable cells by field_key
unit.claim: The RDG-backed workbook grid binds Timeline columns from the active `view_schema` and commits writable cells by authoritative `field_key`.
unit.out_of_scope: Vendor-specific RDG behavior stays with adapter tests; this row owns workbook binding only.

unit.title: Phase 3 U-3-GRID-02 binds saved rows by record_id and row_version instead of visible row index
unit.claim: The RDG-backed workbook grid keeps saved-row identity bound to `record_id` and `row_version` rather than visible row position.
unit.out_of_scope: Real browser reorder regressions remain supplemental coverage.

unit.title: Phase 3 U-3-GRID-03 keeps sorted and filtered local edits bound to the original record_id, base_row_version, and field_key
unit.claim: The RDG-backed workbook grid keeps sorted and filtered local edits bound to the original `record_id`, `base_row_version`, and `field_key`.
unit.out_of_scope: End-to-end browser interaction remains supplemental because this row owns workbook binding semantics.

integration.claim: Real HTTP create, patch, review, supersede, replay, mutation history, projection maintenance, WebSocket invalidation, and rollback stay transactionally coherent.
The query route reads projection rows instead of source rows, and deterministic rebuild restores the same Timeline query surface.
Incident-role authorization, review and supersede legality, replay semantics, replacement-target guards, and supersede change-set shape all hold on the live route surface.
integration.out_of_scope: Systematic route-matrix inventory remains support-only evidence.

e2e.title: E-3-01 creates a Timeline row in-grid and continues editing on the draft row
e2e.claim: A user creates a Timeline row on the real workbook surface and immediately continues editing on the fresh draft row without leaving the grid.

e2e.title: E-3-02 measures user-visible typing_ack and blank-row-create completion within the Phase 3 envelope
e2e.claim: The isolated measurement suite proves one real-stack visible `Syncing -> Saved` transition under controlled latency, then measures typing acknowledgement and blank-row-create completion against the Phase 3 envelope.

e2e.title: E-3-03 drives review, demotion, and supersede through the visible workbook surface
e2e.claim: A reviewer-session browser flow visibly performs review, material-edit demotion, legal supersede, and post-supersede disabling on the workbook surface.
e2e.out_of_scope: Durable substrate counts and replay internals remain backend or disclosed hybrid evidence.

e2e.title: E-3-04 uses a disclosed hybrid replay harness to prove replay avoids duplicate history and visible invalidation
e2e.claim: Real browser replay preserves the original committed result, avoids duplicate history growth, and suppresses duplicate visible invalidation.
e2e.out_of_scope: The disclosed snapshot harness is intentionally test-only and not part of runtime behavior.
